sections.title: Roofing services in Mission
paras: Our shop is in Edinburg, and we've been roofing in Hidalgo County since 2003. Mission is about 25 minutes away and we're there often. We replace roofs in the older neighborhoods near downtown, work on newer homes out in the Sharyland area, and handle commercial roofs along Expressway 83.

Mission grew fast to the west and north over the last twenty years, so most houses fall into one of two groups. About 15% of Mission homes were built before 1980 and are often on their second or third roof. About half were built in 2000 or later, and many of those still have their first roof, now around 20 years old (Census ACS 2020 to 2024). Each group needs something different, and we'll tell you which one your house is in.

sections.title: Roofing services we offer in Mission

cards.title: Residential Roof Replacement
cards.body: The old roof comes all the way off and a new one goes on. We install CertainTeed, Owens Corning and GAF shingles. Each job comes with a written estimate and a check of the decking, and we leave the site clean.

cards.title: Roof Repairs
cards.body: Leaks, missing shingles after a wind, bad flashing, skylights that drip. We fix the spot where the water gets in, which isn't always the spot you can see. Most repairs take one visit.

cards.title: Commercial Roofing
cards.body: Flat and low slope roofs for Mission shops, strip centers and other commercial buildings. We put on TPO, EPDM and modified bitumen, and repair leaks on the flat roof you have now.

cards.title: Storm & Hail Damage
cards.body: We check for hail hits, wind uplift and lost granules, then give you a written report. That report is what you show your insurance company.

cards.title: Roof Inspections
cards.body: A close look at the shape your roof is in. Worth doing before you buy a house, after a storm, or when you've noticed something and want a roofer to look. We walk it, write it up and give you a straight answer.

cards.title: Roof Coatings
cards.body: A reflective coating rolled over an existing commercial or flat roof. It gives the roof more years and cuts the heat on the building. It's the cheaper choice when the roof underneath is still sound but wearing.

sections.title: What roofing problems are most common in Mission?
paras: In the older parts of Mission, around Conway Avenue and the side streets toward downtown, a lot of homes have shingle roofs that have already been through more Valley summers than they were rated for. On those we usually recommend a full replacement. Patching a roof that is already past its life tends to get you one more season and not much more.

Out in the Sharyland area and the newer subdivisions west and north of town, the roofs are younger and the work changes. We see more storm damage and more flashing and vent problems, and a lot of those homes really do just need a repair. If that's your house, we'll fix it and leave the replacement for later.

The stores along Expressway 83 and the businesses near Mission Regional Medical Center mostly have flat or low slope roofs. Those fail in a different way than a sloped roof. Water sits instead of running off, so a small problem stays wet and spreads. By the time you see a stained ceiling tile, the hole can be a good distance away. Finding it is most of the job.

Every roof in Mission deals with the same thing: heat. Strong sun and long stretches of high temperatures break shingles down faster in the Valley than almost anywhere else in the country. A roof that would last 25 years somewhere cooler won't last that long here. Hail comes through a few times a decade too, so get the roof checked after any real storm.

faqs.q: Does Edel Roofing serve Mission, TX?
faqs.a: Yes. We're in Mission often for home replacements, repairs and commercial roofs. Our shop is in Edinburg, about 25 minutes away. Call or book online and we'll get a free inspection on the calendar.

faqs.q: How much does a roof replacement cost in Mission?
faqs.a: A full shingle replacement on a typical Mission home usually costs between $8,000 and $18,000. The size and pitch of the roof, what we're tearing off and the shingle you choose decide where you land. The estimate is written, free and comes before any work. Call or book an inspection to get your number.

faqs.q: Do I need a full replacement or can my roof be repaired?
faqs.a: It comes down to how old the roof is and how much of it is damaged. If the shingles are close to worn out, a repair usually holds for a season and then you replace it anyway. If the roof is younger and the damage is in one area, repair it. We'll look and tell you which one you have, even if the answer is that you don't need us yet.

faqs.q: Do you handle insurance claims for storm or hail damage in Mission?
faqs.a: We inspect the damage and write up what we find, and you use that when you file. We are not a public adjuster. We will walk you through what we saw so you know what you're giving your insurance company.

faqs.q: How do I get a roofing estimate in Mission?
faqs.a: Call (956) 422-3335 or book online at the link above. We set up a visit, look at the roof, measure it and hand you a written estimate. There's no charge and no obligation.
